==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I tell my friends about my recent UFO sightings. One of my friends is so excited, that they throw away a report they wrote. They start working on a new report about UFOs instead.

I appear inside of a store. It has a bunch of cool items like personal robots. Despite this, I struggle to find anything I actually want.

I start writing a rap. I write the line "to best the beat, release the beast, totally and tonally". When I wake up, I feel like I can hear a hip-hop instrumental.
